column1: # Edit decision list for montage/out/anteriormente.mp4 (v2). Read by build.py and captions.py.
# Times are m:ss.xx in montage/src/2023.mp4. In/out points sit in silences found on the
# audio envelope (not on whisper word times, which drift up to ~0.4 s in this recording).
# shots: " | "-separated framing changes; the first starts at `in`, the rest at their time.
#   mode: comp (black composite: Carlos panel + slide) | face (Carlos punch-in) | slide | wide
#   zoom: "1.0" static, "a>b" slow push over the shot, "a~b" snap zoom (fast ease) to b
#   @x,y viewport centre (0-1 of the plate); fy=N top row of the face crop; dx=N slide crop offset
# card rows: in=card, out=duration (s), shots=key=value;… (kind=stamp | q2026)
# sfx: hit@T[:dB]  (T = source time for clips, seconds from the card start for cards)
